actions: Efficiency decline is now confirmed for a third straight week (chats down 30.8%, cost per chat up 66.9%). The wait and monitor approach from the last two reads hasn't worked. Pause the weakest CTR ad sets this week rather than flagging again.

CTR at a new low (0.58%) and CPM up 47.9% both point to worsening audience fatigue. This needs a genuinely new audience or creative angle, not incremental tweaks to the same ad sets.
